selection_rule: Keyless means the corrected extraction rules of agent_bazaar.ingestion.listing_metadata find no security scheme, no global security requirement, no required credential parameter, no platform host and no statement about a key in the prose. Only such a tool may be probed live, because a probe of a keyed tool fails without a credential; the earlier list of this file wrongly kept ideal-postcodes-co-uk, geodatasource-com, interzoid-com-getzipinfo, nexmo-com-pricing and europeana-eu, and the corrected rules now detect the credential in each of them and drop all five. The set holds 11 of the 12 to 15 tools the proposal asks for: the corpus in data/specs holds 98 documents and exactly 11 of them are keyless, so the shortfall is one tool and no further extraction rule can close it - the corpus needs another keyless document. 8 of the 11 map onto a curated capability of the application (GeocodeLocation: deutschebahn-com-fahrplan, deutschahn-com-flinkster, miataru-com; GetWeatherForecast: oceandrivers-com; SearchResearchPapers: cybertaxonomy-eu, ideaconsult-net-nanoreg, parliament-uk-search, parliament-uk-bills). balldontlie-io, crediwatch-com-covid19 and moderatecontent-com are keyless but cover none of the curated capabilities, so they are kept as mechanical keyless probes with an empty capability_hint. ConvertCurrency and GetPublicHolidays are not covered by this probe set: nexmo-com-pricing was the only currency source in the corpus and it needs api_key and api_secret parameters, and no keyless document in the corpus publishes public holidays, which the application covers with the Nager.Date provider instead.

tools.reason: Keyless per the corrected extraction rules and declared free: the document offers a FREE plan with a maximum of 10 requests per minute and asks the reader to ignore the console message about an access token. /location/{name} resolves a place name to a location with coordinates, which covers GeocodeLocation, and /arrivalBoard and /departureBoard cover a live transport answer.

Keyless per the corrected extraction rules and declared free. /areas and /bookingproposals search mobility stations around a coordinate pair and return the stations with their coordinates, so the tool answers a location lookup without a key.

The tool covers none of the curated capabilities of the application, so it is kept only as a mechanical probe of a keyless call.
